newsitem.title: UK: Burton denies chief executive quitting.
newsitem.headline: Burton denies chief executive quitting.

text.p: British retailer Burton Group Plc said on Friday reports that its chief executive John Hoerner was set to resign were "complete nonsense".
"Press reports about John Hoerner's resignation are complete nonsense," a Burton spokesman said.
Reports in the Independent newspaper that Burton's sales were slowing and Hoerner was set to quit pushed Burton shares down two pence weaker at 122-1/4 by 0810 GMT.
"There was a very bearish report in the Independent and that's knocked their share price today," one market-maker said.
The newspaper said Hoerner was a popular figure in the City of London and his departure would be seen as a surprise.
Shares have also been hit this week by news the company would drop out of the FTSE 100 share index from June 23.
